question: If you lose your e-bike's charger, is it safe to use any third-party charger whose plug fits and voltage looks right?
true_option: No — use only the charger supplied or approved by the manufacturer for that battery
false_option: Yes — any charger with a matching plug and voltage rating is safe
true_claim_text: only the manufacturer-supplied or approved charger should be used with an e-bike battery
false_claim_text: any charger with a matching plug and voltage is safe for an e-bike battery
source: CPSC and NFPA e-bike guidance: charge only with the charger that came with the device or a manufacturer-approved replacement; mismatched chargers are a leading cause of lithium-ion battery fires.
